notes.title: From Nava @ Dreamhack Atlanta 2024
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939803/07a07dbd2235f600b6b044d4d20fb8c097eaa37b.png[/img]

Nava Labs is proud to announce that From Nava and our newest entry Sylvie's Constellation will be at Dreamhack Atlanta 2024 from October 4th to 6th at the Georgia World Congress Center! Try out our newest builds of From Nava. and enjoy a sneak peek at a brand new project from us at Nava Labs! We will also be announcing new information, including the release date, at Dreamhack, so meet us there as we head towards accomplishing the dream us student developers have strived to reach!

If you are interested in attending Dreamhack, please use our discount code SYLVIESCONSTELLATION to get 15% off 1 and 3 day passes.

See you there!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939803/da97673d45e9afa18f5953a879c0673023599491.png[/img]

notes.title: From Nava Demo Available Now!
notes.content:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939803/dcd75832417e82dcc9be4c0c96e42cc96c4f6564.gif[/img]

Try out the first parts of the game today. We also have a feedback form, so please fill it out. Your responses are greatly appreciated!
